conditions_results.Condition: Features' Predictive Power Score is less than 0.8

title.text: Predictive Power Score (PPS) - Can a feature predict the label by itself?

display.payload: The Predictive Power Score (PPS) is used to estimate the ability of a feature to predict the label by itself (Read more about Predictive Power Score). A high PPS (close to 1) can mean that this feature's success in predicting the label is actually due to data leakage - meaning that the feature holds information that is based on the label to begin with.

check.summary: Detects outliers in a dataset using the LoOP algorithm. Read More...

display.payload: The Outlier Probability Score is calculated by the LoOP algorithm which measures the local deviation of density of a given sample with respect to its neighbors. These outlier scores are directly interpretable as a probability of an object being an outlier (see link for more information).
